notes: Both margins ('the shadow is gone forward ...' and 'Or, degrees') were read and set aside; the printed text governs under rule 38.

'forward' is added under rule 44's particle test: 'go' already writes the whole lexeme of הלך, so the direction answers to no morpheme, exactly as 'back' is added for a hiphil of בוא. The 'back' of יָשׁוּב is retained with its verb, since 'go' alone does not write the returning.
No interrogative particle stands in the first question, so its fronted 'shall' is the verb's own under rule 17, while the אִם opening the second takes the written 'or' as its one connective.
